summary: Materialize source-bound post-commit Lithuanian mail display work through common durable Task and Run accounting
evidence: The explicit one-mail CLI retains a private one-call file claim, but canonical newly captured mail has no automatic common durable Task/Run display job. Filesystem publication after a DB commit would create a separate orphan/recovery gap. Existing runner post-execute validation/final-authority failures lose already observed usage and Record rejects unknown usage. Use a distinct explicitly bounded policy/one-call Job and atomically committed DB Record over existing helpers, not an acquisition fourth role or second queue.
rollback: Hold separate display flags/actor list and disable policy only; preserve common Task/Run and immutable charged Job history, original mail and legacy sidecars/claims. Revert new display handler/CLI/projection after idle verification. Helper0047 downgrade refuses populated history. No acquisition budget, transport or original MailMessage rewrite.
